messages:
anya: Auditor sent a follow-up — they want evidence that ephemeral KMS keys used for model cache encryption are rotated and how RBAC changes are recorded. Also want mapping to SOC2/ISO controls. Any ideas on snapshots to pull?
marco: Can we produce a correlated timeline of key creation/rotation + IAM role changes? SIEM has the events but we need a join key.
devsec: Yes. Export CloudTrail KMS events + IAM role change events, include PR/ticket links for approvals. Produce CSV and compute checksum. :white_check_mark:
auditor_jane: CSV preferred with columns: eventTime,eventType,principal,resource,requestParams,requestID. Also retention proof: hash of exported file and a presigned S3 link would be fine.
marco: I'll run queries. Proposed evidence retention: 2 years for audit artifacts; live log retention remains 180 days. We'll include sampled logs around rotation windows + config backups.
anya: Command I'll run to pull KMS events: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:12345:key/abcd-ef --start-time 2024-06-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z > kms-rotation-june24.json```
devsec: Also include the RBAC PR reference: PR #789 (infra: rotate kms key, update role bindings). Attach approval thread screenshot. For automated change detections, export OPA eval logs: ```gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_container AND jsonPayload.opa_evaluation=true' --limit 1000```
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Created evidence bundle /s3://redwood-audit/evidence/4376543210/kms-rotation-bundle.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days)
auditor_jane: Good. Can you confirm whether ephemeral keys generate distinct envelope keys for inference cache vs storage? Need separation-of-duties mapping.
marco: Yes — inference cache uses per-tenant data-keys (envelope encryption). CMK is only used to encrypt data-keys; storage uses a different envelope pattern. Will document dataflow and include diagram in the bundle.
anya: For RBAC change trail: pull GH PR metadata + GitOps commit + CI logs showing merge/authorized actor. Quick git query example: ```git log --pretty=format:'%h,%an,%ad,%s' origin/main -- manifests/roles | head -n 100```
devsec: Plan: assemble export CSV, compute SHA256, upload to s3, and create evidence manifest (filename,sha256,description,controls_covered). Who can draft the manifest template?
marco: I'll draft and post in this thread. ETA EOD. :clock1:
anya: Thanks. @auditor_jane if you need more granular SIEM exports (user-agent, IP, geo) call it out now. Otherwise we'll hand off the bundle by EOD and open a follow-up ticket for any deep-dive asks.
